## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

### 1. 本季度收入同比增长百分比、计算过程与原始数字

**结论：同比增长 32%。**

**出处：**
- 新闻稿 `press_release.txt` 中明确写道："Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"
- 财报 `financial_statements.txt` 的 Segment Results 工作表中给出两个期间原始数字：
  - FY26 Q4（Three Months Ended June 30, 2026）：Intelligent Cloud Revenue = **$39,306 million**
  - FY25 Q4（Three Months Ended June 30, 2025）：Intelligent Cloud Revenue = **$29,878 million**
- `metrics.txt` 中的 Metrics 表也确认："Intelligent Cloud … Q4'26 Revenue 39306 … Q4'25 Revenue 29878 … % Change Y/Y 32%"

**计算过程：**

同比增长率 = (本期收入 − 上年同期收入) / 上年同期收入 × 100
= ($39,306 − $29,878) / $29,878 × 100
= $9,428 / $29,878 × 100
≈ 31.56%

微软报告口径下四舍五入为 **32%**（按 GAAP 报告口径；按恒定汇率调整为 31%）。

### 2. 管理层在财报电话会上把增长归因于哪些因素（引用原话）

**出处：** `transcript.txt` 第 ~24808 行起，Amy Hood（CFO）的分段讲解。

Amy Hood 对 Intelligent Cloud 分部整体给出的归因要点如下：

**① 客户需求持续超过可用产能（Azure 增长 43% 是主要驱动力）**
> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity."

**② 效率提升与流程改进使新产能更快上线并被快速货币化**
> "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized."

**③ GitHub Copilot 业务模式变更后消费量超预期**
> "Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."

**④ 整体需求强劲（公司层面表述）**
> Satya Nadella 在开场陈述中："Azure surpassed $100 billion, up 41%."（注：这是全年口径而非 Q4 分部数据，但反映了 AI 平台的整体强劲需求。）
> Amy Hood 在公司层面总结："This quarter, revenue was $90 billion, up 18% … driven by strong demand across both the Azure platform and our first-party AI applications and services."

**⑤ On-premises server 业务表现稳健（分部内的次要贡献）**
> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."

### 3. 归因条目的事实/前瞻性标注

| # | 归因因素 | 性质 | 依据 |
|---|---------|------|------|
| ① | **客户需求持续超过可用产能** → Azure 43% 增长 | **已发生的事实** | Amy Hood 用现在时陈述 "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity"（现在时态描述 Q4 期间持续存在的状态），且 Azure Q4 43% 增长是已报告的财务结果（`press_release.txt` 与 `financial_statements.txt` 均确认） |
| ② | **CPU/GPU 集群效率提升 + 流程改进使新产能更快交付** | **已发生的事实** | Amy Hood 用过去时描述本季度已实现的成果："efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized."（"was quickly monetized" 明确指 Q4 已发生的事） |
| ③ | **GitHub Copilot 业务模式变更后消费量超预期** | **已发生的事实** | "stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change"——6 月业务模式变更已发生，消费量结果是 Q4 已观察到的实际数据 |
| ④ | **On-premises server 业务续约带来更高的当期收入确认** | **已发生的事实** | Amy Hood 用过去时："Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts." 描述 Q4 已完成的结果 |
| ⑤ | **未来 Azure 增长将保持领先、H1 增长将加速** | **前瞻性表述** | Amy Hood 在展望部分说："Even with the strong close to Q4, we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate."（"continue to expect" 明确为未来指引）；以及 "we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply"（"continue to exceed supply" 是对未来的假设） |
| ⑥ | **FY27 Intelligent Cloud 收入指引 $40.95–$41.25B，增长 33%–34%** | **前瞻性表述** | 这是对 Q1 FY27 和全年 FY27 的指引，明确属于"forward-looking guidance"，Amy Hood 在 Outlook 部分给出 |

**区分依据总结：**
- **事实**：使用过去时态（was, grew, increased, were ahead of expectations）或对已报告财务结果的直接描述，指向 Q4 FY26 已经发生并被记录的事件。
- **前瞻性表述**：使用 "expect"、"continue to expect"、"we remain focused on delivering"、"will accelerate" 等展望性措辞，或明确标注为 "outlook" / "guidance" 的内容，指向未来尚未发生的业绩。
